turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're moving from Edinburgh to Bristol with a one bedroom flat's worth of stuff.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Big trip. You could rent a van and drive it yourselves over two days, or pay a removal company and take the train down. Is it more about money or about sanity?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, can you wait? My friend is talking to me. Keep quiet until I come back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hannah, about the fuel for the trip.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Oh, right. How much do I owe you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I filled up twice, so call it half of that. I've got the receipts somewhere.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Don't worry about receipts. I'll just send it tonight.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are you sure? It feels weird asking.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's weirder if you don't. You drove the whole way.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Back to the long move. Drive it yourselves, or hire a firm?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We'll drive. It could be a fun little adventure.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then break it up with a night halfway, and load the heaviest stuff at the front of the van.
